{{Top|leg}}
'''Thugger's Alley''' was an alleyway in the [[Orange District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] had his hideout after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
